verdict.rationale: The Division publishes exact deadlines and penalty terms. Corporate annual reports and franchise taxes are due on or before March 1, and missing them costs a $200 penalty plus 1.5% interest per month on tax and penalty (supp-2). Alternative entities owe $400 by June 1 (docs-12), and taxpayers owing $5,000 or more pay quarterly installments of 40/20/20/remainder on set dates (docs-13). Missing for 10: a published late-penalty figure for the June 1 alternative-entity tax and for missed quarterly estimates, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the schedule.
